# Memo from Erez and Justin: Announcing our Series B

By Erez Cohen and Justin Schram

We’re excited to announce that August Health has secured $29 million in Series B funding, led by Base10 Partners, to further our mission to empower the essential work of caring for our elders. Our existing investors, General Catalyst and Matrix Partners are participating in the round, along with new strategic partners Equitage Ventures and the Senior Living Transformation Company.

“August Health is redefining senior living technology,” said Adam Kaplan, Co-Founder and Partner of Equitage Ventures and CEO and Founder of Solera Living. “They’ve emerged as a frontrunner shaping the future of the industry, providing a modern, data-driven platform that transforms care and operations so that communities can thrive.”

# 🩺 August AI: Building an AI Health Companion for India · 2026-08-12T00:00:00+00:00

🩺 August AI: Building an AI Health Companion for India

August AI, a Bengaluru-based healthtech startup, was founded in 2022 by Anuruddh Mishra. The company is building an AI-powered health companion that helps people understand symptoms, health concerns and medical information between doctor visits.

🚀 Latest Update

On August 12, 2026, August AI made headlines as it reportedly entered talks to raise around $4 million from Peak XV Partners.

This would come on top of the $3 million seed round the startup raised in October 2025 from Accel and Claypond Capital.

August AI’s vision is to make healthcare information more accessible and easier to understand using AI — while supporting, rather than replacing, doctors.

Why it matters: August AI represents a growing wave of Indian healthtech startups using AI to make healthcare more accessible and personalised.

Sukreet Madhok Raj Jayavant Animesh Mishra 👽 Leo S Vaibhav Singhal

Congratulations to the August AI team on building at the intersection of AI and healthcare. Wishing the team continued growth and success in the journey ahead! 🚀

# Exclusive: AI Healthtech Startup August AI In Talks To Raise $4 Mn From Peak XV

 12 Aug'26 | By Debarghya Sil 

 

SUMMARY

August AI is in talks to raise about $4 Mn from Peak XV Partners, sources told Inc42.

The potential deal underscores growing investor interest in startups using AI across health assistance, disease detection, and clinical workflows.

The development comes about 10 months after August AI raised $3 Mn in a seed funding round from Accel and Claypond Capital

AI health companion startup August AI is in talks to raise about $4 Mn from Peak XV Partners, sources told Inc42. 

The contours of the proposed transaction, including the startup’s valuation and the participation of other investors, could not be ascertained. The discussions are ongoing and the terms of the deal may change, the sources added. 

August AI founder Anuruddh Mishra and Peak XV did not respond to Inc42’s queries until the time of publication, while existing investor Accel declined to comment.
